Name: Clint Valley
Author: Bullchicken
Description:
Do you just love Clint and want so so much more of him? Or maybe you're just a masochist?
Well do I have the mod for you then! It's all Clints, all the way down!
It's time for the town incel to excel!

[size=6]Welcome to Clint Valley![/size]

[b]Note:[/b] This probably won't work with other character sprite or portrait mods, but why would you want any other mod than this??

[b]Bugs:[/b] IDK, there might be some animation weirdnesses, but it's just part of the charm really.

[b]1.1.5 Update:[/b] Added option to choose Saucy Buff Clint or Regular Clint (default is Saucy).
[b]1.1.2 Update:[/b] Added option to show or hide custom title screen (default is show).
[b]1.1.1 Update:[/b] Oooh its big, added winter and beach clothes, changed dialogs (please let me know if I missed any).
[b]1.0.1 Update:[/b] Changed the name of the mod to Clint Valley.

Huge thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/bluestarkiller?gameId=1303]bluestarkiller [/url]for letting me use his amazing Clint sprites in this mod
